assets.name: Ara 3D Gen football animation clips (23)
assets.creator: Joshua Olatunde and Ara 3D Gen contributors
assets.licence: MIT (code and generated clips); MakeHuman character data CC0-1.0
assets.usage: Football actions of every 3D player: shots, passes, first touch, chest control, headers, tackles, goalkeeping, throw-ins, a celebration
assets.modifications: Retargeted onto the Mesh2Motion skeleton by scripts/anim/retarget.js (limb error <= 0.3 degrees); resampled at 30 fps; fingers held; contact times added

assets.name: Close-up footballer body m-light (Ara 3D Gen export, optimised)
assets.creator: Joshua Olatunde and Ara 3D Gen contributors (exporter); MakeHuman: Data Collection AB, Joel Palmius, Jonas Hauquier (base mesh, skins, eyes, brows, lashes, shoes06)
assets.licence: MIT (Ara code, its procedural kit and buzz-cut hair); MakeHuman data CC0-1.0; "Characters exported by Ara 3D Gen may be used in commercial and non-commercial projects without attribution"
assets.original: FOOTBALL-RALISM-LAB/outputs/gaffer-bodies/m-light.glb (not in git), exported from tools/character-pipeline/recipes/m-light.params.json by Ara 3D Gen commit 76d4e13 with the Windows targets fix
assets.usage: Player Studio preview and award ceremonies (close-ups only; not the match players)
assets.modifications: tools/character-pipeline/optimise.mjs: jersey number geometry dropped; kit and boots simplified; boot upper made into sock; skin under the sock removed; rebound onto the Mesh2Motion skeleton; 16 materials merged into 4 with atlased WebP textures; attributes quantised.
